caption: The drawing features a central human figure with long dark hair, wearing a long flowing robe, predominantly colored in red and brown vertical stripes with black and brown outlines. The figure has a halo with red radiating lines around the head, and a flat, disc-like brown object above the head. In the right hand, the figure holds a large brown palm frond, while the left hand holds a staff-like object topped with a burst or star shape. The background is filled with curved brown lines resembling drapery or curtains, with additional black and brown curved lines forming a border around the rectangular composition. To the lower right of the figure, there are three arched shapes colored in dark brown or black, positioned on a lighter brown patch near the base of the drawing. The entire scene is rendered in muted and earthy tones, including brown, black, red, and tan, with a sketchy, loosely painted style. The drawing is framed by a plain off-white border, and there is handwritten text in red ink below the image.
title: Santos Retablos
